# up to two subscription filters can be associated with a log group
        if len(self.subscription_filters) > 1:
            # If we already have 2 filters and this is a new filter name, raise error
            if not any(f["filterName"] == filter_name for f in self.subscription_filters):
                raise LimitExceededException("Resource limit exceeded.")

        # If we're updating an existing filter, preserve its creation time
        creation_time = int(unix_time_millis())
        for filter in self.subscription_filters:
            if filter["filterName"] == filter_name:
                creation_time = filter["creationTime"]
                break

        # Update streams
        for stream in self.streams.values():
            stream.destination_arn = destination_arn
            stream.filter_name = filter_name

        # Create new filter dict
        new_filter = {
            "filterName": filter_name,
            "logGroupName": self.name,
            "filterPattern": filter_pattern,
            "destinationArn": destination_arn,
            "roleArn": role_arn,
            "distribution": "ByLogStream",
            "creationTime": creation_time,
        }

        # Update filters list - replace existing filter or append new one
        updated_filters = []
        filter_updated = False
        for filter in self.subscription_filters:
            if filter["filterName"] == filter_name:
                updated_filters.append(new_filter)
                filter_updated = True
            else:
                updated_filters.append(filter)
        if not filter_updated:
            updated_filters.append(new_filter)
        self.subscription_filters = updated_filters
